name: proto-gateway-server-mode
description: A gateway registered in server mode converts the server to the server interface and forwards each HTTP request to its method, which binds nothing: the handler is a dead implementer and the RPC's client method is unreferenced, so the gateway keeps no RPC live.
pending: references-go.12: deadset-go reads a gateway's forwarding as binding nothing and its server argument as an implementer (GO5).
